title: Impulse Body Text 1
description: Assisted Solos are a creative tool and training exercise Thomas Hauert and Zoo Company have been using over the years.  In Assisted Solos, partners or assistants provide external impulses for a soloist in a series of different improvisation strategies from the introductory Light Touches to more complex forms involving several people and changing roles.
